en.name: Turbo JSON Viewer
en.summary: Fast, local JSON viewer for large files: worker-resident parsing, search, JS expressions and temporary edits. Nothing is uploaded.
description: Turbo JSON Viewer is a fast, fully local JSON viewer. Open a JSON file, paste JSON, or select JSON text on a page and open it in the viewer — everything is parsed and rendered on your own machine. No uploads, no accounts, no network requests.
BUILT FOR LARGE FILES
• Documents live in a background worker; the page only ever holds the rows on screen.
• 10 MB opens in a fraction of a second; the same pipeline is tested with 50 MB / ~3M nodes.
• Fixed-height row virtualization keeps scrolling smooth on huge arrays.
FIND WHAT MATTERS
• Search keys, values and JSON paths, with case-sensitive, regular-expression and whole-word modes.
• Filter results by keys / values / paths, hide individual hits, jump between them with Enter or ⌘G.
• Outline panel for structure navigation, plus a raw source view with two-way jump to the tree.
QUERY WITH EXPRESSIONS
• Filter or project with a JavaScript expression such as $.orders.filter(o => o.total > 100), evaluated by a safe built-in interpreter — no eval, no remote code.
• Results open as their own view; click a row to jump back to the original document.
WORK WITH SEVERAL DOCUMENTS
• Up to 8 documents in tabs, each with its own selection, scroll position and search.
EDIT AND EXPORT
• Edit any subtree as JSON in a temporary, in-memory draft; the source file is never modified.
• Export or copy with lossless big integers, configurable indentation, and a system Save dialog.
PRIVACY
• No data collection, no telemetry, no network access. Documents never leave this device.
• Only the storage permission (for your preferences) and a right-click menu for selected text.
NOTES
• Read-only by design: the viewer never writes to your files, and exports go through a Save dialog you control.
• The expression language is a JavaScript subset (filter/map/etc.), not full JavaScript.
en.singlePurpose: Open, browse, search and filter a JSON document locally, and export or copy parts of it.

permissions.storage: Stores only interface preferences (theme, language, indentation, import destination). Document content is never stored.
permissions.contextMenus: Adds one right-click submenu (Open in viewer / Download JSON) for the text you selected. The extension does not read pages and has no host permissions.

en.remoteCode: No. All code ships inside the package; the app makes no network requests.

dataUsage.collects: No. JSON you open is parsed and rendered in memory on your device; nothing is transmitted, sold or shared.
dataUsage.disclosure: The extension processes document content locally only, stores interface preferences with chrome.storage.local, and has no remote endpoints.
dataUsage.limitedUse: Certify: data is not sold or transferred to third parties, is not used for unrelated purposes, and is not used to determine creditworthiness.

testInstructions: 1) Click the extension icon (or the toolbar action) to open the full-page viewer in a new tab.
2) Paste any JSON with ⌘V / Ctrl+V, or drop a .json file onto the page. The tree appears immediately.
3) Try the search box (magnifier in the left rail): type a key or value, then Enter to jump to hits.
4) Try the expression panel ({ } icon): run $.data.filter(x => x != null) against a document with a $.data array.
5) Right-click a row to copy a subtree, or use the Edit action to open the temporary subtree editor.
6) To test the context menu: select JSON text on a normal web page, right-click, choose Turbo JSON Viewer → Open in viewer.

Notes for reviewers: the package contains no remote code and no network calls. The expression evaluator is a JavaScript-subset interpreter built on acorn; the only identifier named eval in the bundle is an internal RPC method (core.eval), not the global eval, and no dynamic code execution is used.
screenshotCaptions: Tree view: every value, type column, selected node and document profile
Search: keys, values and paths with hits highlighted in the tree
Expression filter: results open as their own view, still linked to the source
Multiple documents: up to 8 tabs, each with its own state
Temporary subtree editing: edit JSON in memory, the source file is never touched

zh.name: Turbo JSON Viewer
zh.summary: 本地 JSON 查看器：Worker 常驻解析超大文件，搜索、JS 表达式过滤与临时编辑，数据不上传。
description: Turbo JSON Viewer 是一个快速、完全本地的 JSON 查看器。打开 JSON 文件、粘贴 JSON，或在网页上选中 JSON 文本直接打开——解析与渲染全部在你自己的机器上完成。不上传、不注册、不发任何网络请求。
为超大文件而生
• 文档常驻后台 Worker，页面只持有屏幕上那几十行。
• 10 MB 几乎秒开；同一条管线已用 50 MB / 约 300 万节点验证。
• 固定行高虚拟化，巨大数组里滚动依然跟手。
快速定位
• 搜索键名、值与 JSON 路径，支持区分大小写、正则与全字匹配。
• 结果可按 键名 / 值 / 路径 过滤，逐条隐藏，Enter 或 ⌘G 上下跳转。
• 大纲面板做结构导航；原文视图与树视图双向跳转。
表达式筛选
• 用 JS 表达式过滤或投影，例如 $.orders.filter(o => o.total > 100)；内置安全解释器，无 eval、无远程代码。
• 结果作为独立视图打开，点任意一行回到原文档对应位置。
多文档
• 最多 8 个文档标签，每个标签各自保留选中、滚动与搜索状态。
编辑与导出
• 任意子树可当 JSON 临时编辑（只在内存里），原文件永不修改。
• 导出/复制支持无损大整数、可配缩进，文件导出走系统「另存为」。
隐私
• 不收集数据、无遥测、无网络访问；文档不离开本机。
• 只用 storage 权限（存你的偏好）与一个针对选中文本的右键菜单。
说明
• 设计上只读：查看器不写你的文件，导出由你在系统框里确认。
• 表达式语言是 JavaScript 子集（filter/map 等），不是完整 JS。
zh.singlePurpose: 在本地打开、浏览、搜索与过滤一份 JSON 文档，并导出或复制其中一部分。

permissions.storage: 只存界面偏好（主题、语言、缩进、导入落点），不存文档内容。
permissions.contextMenus: 为选中的文本增加一个右键子菜单（在查看器中打开 / 下载 JSON）。扩展不读取网页内容，也没有 host 权限。

zh.remoteCode: 否。所有代码都在包内，应用不发任何网络请求。

dataUsage.collects: 否。打开的 JSON 只在本机内存中解析与渲染，不上传、不出售、不共享。
dataUsage.disclosure: 文档内容仅本地处理；界面偏好存在 chrome.storage.local；没有任何远端服务。
dataUsage.limitedUse: 勾选：数据不出售、不转交第三方、不用于无关用途、不用于判定信用。

testInstructions: 1) 点扩展图标，在新的整页标签里打开查看器。
2) ⌘V / Ctrl+V 粘贴任意 JSON，或把 .json 文件拖到页面上，树立刻出现。
3) 用左侧放大镜打开搜索：输入键名或值，Enter 跳到命中。
4) 用 { } 打开表达式面板：对含 $.data 数组的文档运行 $.data.filter(x => x != null)。
5) 右键任意行可复制子树，或用「编辑」打开临时子树编辑器。
6) 右键菜单：在普通网页上选中 JSON 文本 → 右键 → Turbo JSON Viewer → 在查看器中打开。
screenshotCaptions: 树视图：值、类型列、选中节点与文档概要
搜索：键名 / 值 / 路径命中，树上同步高亮
表达式筛选：结果作为独立视图，仍可跳回原文档
多文档：最多 8 个标签，各自保留状态
临时子树编辑：只在内存中改，原文件不动
